title: HushSpec Error Code Registry v1
description: Schema for spec/registries/error-codes.yaml, the registry of stable identifiers an implementation reports when it refuses a HushSpec document, and for the <name>.expect.yaml sidecars that name the code an invalid/ vector must be rejected with.

codes.description: Registered error codes, ordered by code.

Code.description: Error code identifier: the letter E followed by three digits. Once registered, a code's meaning never changes and the code is never reused for a different condition.

summary.description: One-line description, suitable for a table.

description.description: What the code means and which specification requirement it enforces.

phase.description: Where in load -> parse -> validate -> resolve the refusal happens. A code from an earlier phase pre-empts later ones: a document that fails to parse is never validated.

emitted_by.description: Reference-implementation commands that report this code today. Informative.

superseded_by.description: Set when a code is retired: the code that replaces it. A retired code is never reused.

ExpectedError.description: A fixtures/<module>/invalid/<name>.expect.yaml sidecar: the outcome the vector beside it MUST produce. Level 1 requires the rejection; naming the code is required of implementations that emit registry codes (core spec Section 8, Level 1).

reject.description: Always true. The sidecar exists only to describe a refusal; an accepted document has no sidecar.

code.description: The registered code the refusal carries.

message_contains.description: Optional substring the diagnostic must contain, for vectors where the code alone would not distinguish the requirement being tested. Compared literally and case-sensitively.
